description: This is the implementation of a low-level printf function for formatted output in C, including functions for character and string formatting, number conversion, and output via the board_putc external function.

methods.name: void lp_Print(void (* output)(void *,char *,int),void * arg,char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Core low-level printf function that formats arguments based on the format string and outputs characters using a callback.

methods.name: int PrintChar(char * buf,char c,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Formats a single character with specified padding and justification.

methods.name: int PrintString(char * buf,char * s,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Formats a string with specified width and justification.

methods.name: int PrintNum(char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
methods.description: Converts and formats a number to a string in specified base, with handling for negative flag and padding.

methods.name: void printf_output(void * arg,char * s,int l)
methods.description: Output callback that sends characters to `board_putc`, handling newline conversions.

methods.name: void printf(char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Public printf function that processes the format string and variable arguments, calling the low-level formatter.

ctags.name: PrintChar
ctags.pattern: /^PrintChar(char * buf, char c, int length, int ladjust)$/

ctags.name: PrintNum
ctags.pattern: /^PrintNum(char * buf, unsigned long u, int base, int negFlag,$/
ctags.signature: (char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)

ctags.name: PrintString
ctags.pattern: /^PrintString(char * buf, char* s, int length, int ladjust)$/

ctags.name: theFatalMsg
ctags.pattern: /^static const char theFatalMsg[] = "fatal error in lp_Print!";$/
